statement: For every complete finite simple SRG(99,14,1,2) having exactly227 actual induced rook-nine vertex subsets counted once, let r_T count those containing actual triangle T and put d_T=6-r_T. No c>=3 occurs. This does not assert realizability of a listed population, exclude count227 or resolve the target.
